newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says reconciled London Club debt near 60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia says reconciled London Club debt near 60 pct.

text.p: Russia and the London Club of commercial bank creditors have fully reconciled about 60 percent of Russia's debt, bringing a final debt restructuring agreement closer, a senior Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.
"The figure is nearing 60 percent," Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov told Reuters. "The exact figure will be announced in the middle of the next week."
Russia has to fully reconcile 90 percent of the $24 billion principal of its total $35 billion debt to the London Club to close the rescheduling agreement.
The Finance Ministry has promised to start publish fully reconciled debt volumes every week from August.
